meta.title: 4 days in hoi an, vietnam // tailoring clothes, cooking class, coconut boats
meta.description:
Join us on an unforgettable four-day journey through the enchanting city of Hoi An, Vietnam! 🇻🇳 

In this vlog, I will take you through the vibrant streets of Hoi An to go tailor clothes, try out a traditional Vietnamese cooking class, and take a ride on the dizzying coconut boats. We stay at the viral Reu Boutique Hotel which sits on a rice paddy! Plus watch us experience the delicious food culture of bahn mi, local Cau Lau, and the French influence through our meal at Le Comptoir.
